key_insight: diff-soup enables GPU-native, differentiable simulation and inference for large, stiff PDE systems, reporting 10–100× speedups in forward solves and gradients over established CPU- and GPU-based frameworks.
engineering_relevance: Faster PDE-constrained optimization can accelerate physical-model calibration and spatial catalyst-activity inference for reactor engineering.
method: Built in JAX for differentiable computation with sparse structure.
Uses NVIDIA cuDSS sparse direct solves and model/data multi-GPU parallelism.
Supports Bayesian inference and embedded deep learning in PDE-constrained workflows.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports stiff-PDE benchmarks and demonstrations of constitutive-relationship inference and neural-field training for catalyst activity in a 3D packed-bed reactor.
watch_item: GPU memory requirements and NVIDIA cuDSS dependence should be assessed for the target PDE discretization and hardware.
paper_title: diff-soup: GPU-native Differentiable Simulation and Inference for Large-scale Stiff Dynamical Systems
